fact: On 10 August 2024 the Interior Minister said Cityweb rollout was under way in the 690 civil registration centres, 346 already connected (238 of 490 sub-prefectures, 108 of 201 mairies), with birth declaration possible from maternity wards.
title: Modernisation du système d'état civil ivoirien : l'enregistrement des naissances désormais possible depuis les maternités
